item.text: Я перехожу к проверке реализации: прогоню CLI в отдельных процессах, включая ошибки, фильтры, сохранность данных и атомарную запись.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -e
check_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
board_file="$check_dir/board.json"
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$board_file"

run_json() {
  output="$(bun run src/cli.ts "$@")"
  bun -e '"'JSON.parse(process.argv[1])' \""'$output"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$output"
}

add_one="$(run_json add --title '"'First task' --tags 'Work, urgent,work' --due 2026-09-05 | tail -n 1)\"
add_two=\""'$(run_json add --title '"'Second task' --tags 'home' --due 2026-09-07 | tail -n 1)\"
run_json list
run_json list --status open --tag WORK --overdue 2026-09-06
run_json done 1
run_json done 1
run_json stats
run_json delete 2
run_json list

bun -e '
const db = await Bun.file(process.env.TASKBOARD_FILE).json();
if (db.nextId "'!== 3 || db.tasks.length !== 1 || db.tasks[0].id !== 1 || db.tasks[0].status !== "done") throw new Error("persistence invariant failed");
'"'

if bun run src/cli.ts add --title '' >\""'$check_dir/error-out" 2>"$check_dir/error-err"; then
  echo '"'empty title unexpectedly succeeded' >&2
  exit 1
fi
bun -e 'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text())' \""'$check_dir/error-out"
test -s "$check_dir/error-err"

if bun run src/cli.ts add --title bad --due 2025-02-29 >"$check_dir/date-out" 2>"$check_dir/date-err"; then
  echo '"'impossible date unexpectedly succeeded' >&2
  exit 1
fi
bun -e 'JSON.parse(await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).text())' \""'$check_dir/date-out"

before="$(shasum "$board_file")"
printf '"'{broken' >\""'$check_dir/malformed.json"
TASKBOARD_FILE="$check_dir/malformed.json" bun run src/cli.ts list >"$check_dir/malformed-out" 2>"$check_dir/malformed-err" && exit 1 || true
test "$(cat "$check_dir/malformed.json")" = '"'{broken'
after=\""'$(shasum "$board_file")"
test "$before" = "$after"

if find "$check_dir" -name '"'*.tmp' -print -quit | grep -q .; then
  echo 'temporary file leaked' >&2
  exit 1
fi

bun build src/cli.ts --target=bun --outfile=\""'$check_dir/cli.js" >/dev/null
printf '"'SELF_TEST_OK\\n'
"
